C1109.title: AI-Generated Explicit Video Case: Female Billiards Player Wang Sinuo Reports to Police for Rights Protection
C1109.summary: In August 2025, female billiards player Wang Sinuo publicly stated that she was maliciously targeted with AI-generated explicit videos that were subsequently distributed online. She has authorized a lawyer to preserve evidence and initiate legal proceedings, and the police have filed a case for investigation.
